title: Jump Game VII
summary: Start at index zero of a binary string.

contractDetails.constraints: 2–100000 characters, each 0 or 1, with s[0]=0. 1 ≤ minJump ≤ maxJump < length(s). Indices are zero-based.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned bool.

statement: Start at index zero of a binary string. From a reachable index, jump forward by any distance between minJump and maxJump, inclusive, and land only on a zero. Return whether the final index is reachable.

examples.explanation: Jump from 0 to 3, then from 3 to 6.

constraints: 2–100000 characters, each 0 or 1, with s[0]=0. 1 ≤ minJump ≤ maxJump < length(s). Indices are zero-based.
hints: Conceptual: A destination needs one reachable predecessor in an interval.
Directional: Move a window of eligible predecessor indices along the string.
Implementation: Maintain how many reachable indices are in the window. Add the newly eligible index and remove the expired one before evaluating each zero.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
